slots.name: reported incidents
slots.sentence: The decision comes after KRBO reported that Lutheran was involved in two separate incidents where racist remarks were made in games against Sand Creek (CO) and Rampart (CO).

slots.name: investigation status
slots.sentence: Separately, our office continues to gather information regarding the reports involving Lutheran High School. That process is ongoing.
